papers.title: Corrosion resistance characteristics of a Ti-6Al-4V alloy scaffold that is fabricated by electron beam melting and selective laser melting for implantation in vivo

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究EBM和SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V支架的耐腐蚀性能，未涉及应力遮挡或力学测试，与用户方向的直接相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估EBM和SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V支架的耐腐蚀性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过电化学测试对比两种工艺制备支架的腐蚀行为。
summary_zh.result: 两种工艺的支架均表现出良好的耐腐蚀性，但表面形貌影响腐蚀速率。
summary_zh.validation: 体外电化学腐蚀实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the corrosion resistance of Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds fabricated by electron beam melting and selective laser melting for potential in vivo implantation.
summary_en.method: Electrochemical tests were conducted to compare the corrosion behavior of scaffolds produced by the two additive manufacturing techniques.
summary_en.result: Both types of scaffolds exhibited good corrosion resistance, but surface morphology influenced the corrosion rate.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through in vitro electrochemical corrosion experiments.
